Hi Marta (and finance team),

Hope you had a good weekend. We are closing the month-end collection sprint for invoice INV-AUR-411 (attached) and wanted to confirm the final payment path and VAT ownership so we can clear columns in billing and send remittance instructions to your AP. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm preferred payment method (ACH to the bank details on the invoice or wire to the account listed) and an expected settlement date? Our operations team is prioritizing any payments that land by EOD Dec 22 so we can reconcile this quarter.

2) For tax/VAT: are you able to provide the VAT registration certificate for the paying entity, or confirm that Aurelius will take ownership of VAT on this invoice? If you prefer, you can attach the certificate to a reply or upload to the DocuSign envelope I shared (link below).

Attachment: INV-AUR-411.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)
DocuSign remit envelope: https://www.docusign.com/console/documents/abc-123-remit

If we don’t hear back by Tues 12/21 12:00 PT, we’ll follow up with a credit-card fallback note and an expedited wire option. Appreciate a one-line confirmation either way.

Thanks,
